question: As on 31 March 2024, apart from the Ministry of Home Affairs, which of the following ministries is headed by Shri Amit Shah?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Cooperation**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Shri Amit Shah is the head of the **Ministry of Home Affairs** and the **Ministry of Cooperation** as of 31 March 2024.
 
• The Ministry of Cooperation was created to realize the vision of 'Sahkar se Samriddhi' (prosperity through cooperation).
